meta.title: Inside Dispatch
meta.subtitle: C4 level 3: the components of the service that owns parcel state

elements.label: Scan consumer
elements.description: Reads parcel.scanned and orders events by when they happened, not when they arrived

elements.label: State machine
elements.description: The only thing that changes a parcel's status, and refuses any move the table does not permit

elements.label: Attempt policy
elements.description: Decides whether a failed delivery is retried tomorrow or parked for the recipient

elements.label: Route planner
elements.description: Places a parcel on a route and asks the routing engine to sequence it

elements.label: Partner hand-off
elements.description: Sends out-of-area parcels to a partner carrier and stops tracking them

elements.label: Event publisher
elements.description: Emits parcel.delivered, parcel.attempt-failed and parcel.exception after the state change commits

elements.label: Parcel repository
elements.description: The only component here that touches the database

elements.label: Parcel events
elements.description: Where scans arrive from, and where state changes go

elements.label: Relay DB
elements.description: The parcel, route and scan tables

elements.label: Routing engine
elements.description: Sequences a van’s stops under time windows

cards.title: Why this is one service
items: Parcel state, attempt policy and route placement change together; splitting them would need a distributed transaction to stay correct.
Everything grey lives outside Dispatch and is drawn only to show where the edges go.
